summary: Owner-authorized, agent-executed accounting runs (Ed 2026-11-17). Extends the 554-556 owner authorization (authenticated email reply, fingerprints, expiry, permanent evidence) to Kat's accounting runs with batch requests: owner_authorizations scope 'accounting_runs', accounting_run_fingerprint, owner_authorization_request_runs, accounting_run_approve_delegated. No rows change; the in-app approval path is unchanged.

preflight.name: owner_authorizations exists (554)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'owner_authorizations'

preflight.name: the delegated run approval does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'accounting_run_approve_delegated'

expected_changes: owner_authorizations: the scope check also allows 'accounting_runs'.
New functions accounting_run_fingerprint, owner_authorization_request_runs and accounting_run_approve_delegated (service_role only).
No row changes: no run, journal entry or authorization is touched.

verify.name: the scope check allows accounting runs
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'owner_authorizations_scope_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%accounting_runs%'

verify.name: the three functions exist
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('accounting_run_fingerprint', 'owner_authorization_request_runs', 'accounting_run_approve_delegated')
